🎉 **Miyorare 1.0.0 — A New Chapter**

Miyorare has levelled up. Collections are tidier, the interface is prettier, and secret stuff… stays secret. 👀

## ✨ Private Favourites
A dedicated home now exists for collections that should not hang out in Normal Favourites. Categories, navigation, appearance, and themes get their own Private space.

## 📚 Library Groups
Some manga deserve more than alphabetical order. Create groups, choose a local cover, arrange an Advanced Timeline, and build the reading order you actually want. 😌

## 🎨 Favourites Got More Personality
Miyorare, Sakura, Violet, Cyan, Emerald, and Amber now have dedicated header identities. No more pretending that moving the hue slider counts as a whole new outfit. 🌸💜💎

## 🕶️ Private Has Its Own Style Too
Normal can wear Sakura while Private goes Violet. They are grown up now; matching clothes are optional.

## ✨ Miyorare Modern
More of the app now follows Miyorare’s modern, cleaner, more consistent visual language. Classic is still around for anyone saying, “the old one was already comfy.”

## 🔒 Privacy Hardening
Private context is guarded more carefully from places where it should not appear. Because a secret shown in a notification is having a very bad day. 😭

## 🔧 Calmer and More Stable
Navigation, gestures, sorting, selection state, and other rough edges were polished. Some bugs left politely. Others required an escort.

## 🖼️ Final Favourites Artwork
Normal and Private Favourites now use their final dedicated header artwork so every theme has an identity of its own.

## 🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixed selected-state and recreation problems in several flows.
- Reduced navigation and gesture conflicts.
- Improved Private and Favourites stability.
- Added assorted performance and reliability fixes behind the scenes.

> **Thanks for using Miyorare.**
> 1.0.0 is not the finish line. It is simply the point where Miyorare can finally say:
> **“Okay, now I’ve got my own app.”** ✨
